title: HxH Textures
description: A simple Hunter x Hunter themed Resource Pack for Minecraft.
body:
# **Hunter x Hunter Textures** #

This resource pack integrates the visual identity and thematic elements of the Hunter x Hunter universe into Minecraft. Built with a focus on asset fidelity, UI optimization, and gameplay readability, this pack provides a comprehensive thematic overhaul without compromising vanilla performance.


![HxH Textures](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0c52af0349a595b81c0924059d1931130ed7f2af.png)

<details>
<summary>Content</summary>

- Water Bucket → Water Divination
- Elytra → Wings of Mentuthuyoupi
- Enchanted Glint → Nen
- Enchanted Book → Greed Island Book
- Crossbow → Cheetu's Crossbow
- Fishing Rod → Gon's Fishing Rod
- Totem of Undying → Hunter License
- Ender Eye → Scarlet Eyes
- Java Edition → HxH Edition

_More coming soon..._
</details>





<details>
<summary>Install</summary>

To install this resource pack, select your Minecraft version in the download menu, and copy the downloaded file into Minecraft's resourcepacks folder. Alternatively, if you are using the [Modrinth App](https://modrinth.com/app), you can easily add this resource pack to an instance by selecting "Install with Modrinth App" in the download menu.
</details>


<details>
<summary>Support Me</summary>

If you enjoy this texture pack, the best way to help is by subscribing to my YouTube channel [NagaMods](https://www.youtube.com/@NagaMoDss), checking my Modrinth profile for more content, joining my Discord, and following my social media!

Your support keeps this project alive. Thank you for downloading.

</details>
